Bubblo: C5→E5→G5→C6 ascending arpeggio (160ms steps), sine pluck + C6 octave shimmer
Stella: C6→G6→C7 sparkle chime (120/140ms steps), fast-decay sine bells
Wobble: G5→D5→G5→B5 bouncy bounce (140ms steps) + soft triangle boing tail
Aqua: C5→G5→E5 gentle wave sweep (sustained, overlapping sine tones)
Bud: F4 soft pluck (with F5 octave) → C5 echo, warm short decay
Glow: C4+E4+G4 major triad swell (staggered attack) + C5 top note
Spark: D5→G5→B5 quick zap fanfare (100ms steps, soft-square) + D6 sine tail
